question: What are your membership plans?
answer: We offer 3 plans: Basic (₹999/month), Premium (₹1,499/month), and Elite (₹1,999/month). Basic includes gym access, Premium adds classes, Elite includes personal training.

question: Do you offer annual memberships?
answer: Yes! Annual membership is ₹10,999 (saves ₹1,000), Annual Premium is ₹16,999, and Annual Elite is ₹21,999.

question: Is there a registration fee?
answer: Yes, there's a one-time registration fee of ₹500. This includes fitness assessment and orientation.

question: Can I freeze my membership?
answer: Yes, you can freeze for up to 3 months per year at no additional cost. Just notify us 7 days in advance.

question: What is your cancellation policy?
answer: You can cancel anytime without penalty for monthly plans. Annual plans have a 15-day notice period. Full refund if cancelled within 30 days.

question: What are your gym timings?
answer: We're open 5 AM to 11 PM, Monday to Sunday, including holidays. Guided classes run from 6-9 AM and 4-8 PM.

question: Are you open on weekends and holidays?
answer: Yes! We're open on all weekends and national holidays with same timings (5 AM - 11 PM).

question: Can I access the gym 24/7?
answer: No, but Elite members get access until 11 PM (latest). We offer 24/7 access only upon special request for ₹500 extra/month.

question: What equipment do you have?
answer: We have cardio machines (treadmills, ellipticals, bikes), free weights (dumbbells up to 50kg), cable machines, squat racks, and functional training area.

question: Do you have locker facilities?
answer: Yes, we provide free lockers for all members. Bring your own lock or rent one for ₹50/month.

question: Is there a shower and changing room?
answer: Yes! All members have access to clean shower rooms, changing areas, and complimentary towels.

question: Do you have a sauna or steam room?
answer: We have a steam room available for Premium and Elite members only. Basic members can use it for ₹100/visit.

question: What is your parking facility?
answer: Free parking available for all members in our basement. We have 50 spaces with CCTV security.

question: What group classes do you offer?
answer: We offer Yoga, Zumba, CrossFit, Spinning, Pilates, and HIIT. Each class is 45-60 minutes with experienced instructors.

question: Are group classes included in membership?
answer: Yes! Basic plan includes 2 free classes per week. Premium includes unlimited classes. Elite includes private sessions too.

question: Do you offer personal training?
answer: Yes! Personal training sessions cost ₹500 per session or ₹4,500 for 10 sessions. Elite members get 2 free sessions per month.

question: How do I book group classes?
answer: Book through our mobile app or at reception up to 24 hours in advance. Walk-ins are welcome if space available.

question: Can I try a free trial class?
answer: Yes! New members can attend 1 free trial class before joining. Email us or call to schedule your trial.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Cash, Debit/Credit Card, UPI, and net banking. All payments processed securely.

question: Can I pay in installments?
answer: Yes! Annual memberships can be paid in 3 or 12 monthly installments with 0% interest.

question: How will I receive billing invoices?
answer: Invoices are emailed automatically at the start of each billing cycle. You can also download from app.

question: Do you offer corporate memberships?
answer: Yes! Corporate members get 20% discount for 10+ employees. Separate billing with admin dashboard.

question: How often is the gym cleaned?
answer: We clean equipment and floors every 2 hours. Deep cleaning happens daily at 11 PM. All equipment sanitized with hospital-grade disinfectant.

question: What COVID-19 safety measures do you have?
answer: Masks optional. Regular sanitization every 2 hours. Social distancing maintained in classes. Hand sanitizers available throughout gym.

question: Do you have a hygiene guarantee?
answer: 100% equipment hygiene guaranteed. Report any uncleaned equipment and get ₹50 gym credit.

question: Is your gym insured?
answer: Yes, we have comprehensive liability insurance. Your safety is our priority with trained first-aid staff on-site.

question: Can I bring a guest to the gym?
answer: Yes! All members get 2 free guest passes per month. Guest must be accompanied by member at all times.

question: Is there a dress code?
answer: Wear comfortable workout clothes and proper gym shoes. No outdoor clothes or formal wear on gym floor.

question: What are your behavior policies?
answer: Be respectful to all members and staff. No loud music/noise. Proper equipment usage required. Violation = membership cancellation.

question: Do you offer nutrition guidance?
answer: Yes! Premium and Elite members get monthly nutrition consultation. Others can book for ₹500/session.

question: Do you have a merchandise shop?
answer: Yes, we sell gym wear, supplements, and accessories at competitive prices with member discounts (10-20%).

question: Can I get a fitness assessment?
answer: Yes! Included in registration for all members. Reassessment available every 3 months for ₹200.

question: How many members do you have?
answer: We have 2,500+ active members. Join our growing fitness community!

question: Do you have morning/evening batch timings?
answer: Yes! Separate morning (5-9 AM) and evening (4-8 PM) batches for classes with different instructors.

question: Can I transfer my membership to someone else?
answer: No, memberships are non-transferable. However, you can gift a new membership.

question: Do you have special programs for seniors/kids?
answer: Yes, we have senior fitness programs (₹799/month) and kids training (ages 8-16) for ₹599/month.

question: What should I bring on my first day?
answer: Bring your ID proof, workout clothes, shoes, water bottle, and towel.

question: Do you provide water bottles/towels?
answer: Towels are complimentary. Reusable water bottles available at ₹200 or bring your own.

question: How long is a typical workout session?
answer: Most members workout 45-90 minutes. No time limit - stay as long as you like during operating hours.

question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
answer: Yes, 100% refund within 30 days if unsatisfied, no questions asked.

question: Do you have changing room lockers with cameras?
answer: No cameras in changing rooms for privacy. Lockers are monitored by CCTV outside.
